FAQ.q1: How much does a website for my business cost?
FAQ.a1: It depends on what you need. A professional website with your own domain starts from €1,500. Online bookings, e-commerce or extra features are quoted separately. I'll give you a fixed quote with no obligation after understanding your case.
FAQ.q2: How long does it take to be ready?
FAQ.a2: A professional website can be ready in 2-4 weeks. More complex projects (online store, booking app) take 1-3 months. I show you progress every week so you can see how it's going.
FAQ.q3: Do I need to know about technology to have a website?
FAQ.a3: Not at all. I handle everything technical. You just tell me what your business needs and I translate it into a digital solution. Plus, I teach you to manage your site with a simple admin panel.
FAQ.q4: Can I update the website myself afterwards?
FAQ.a4: Yes. All websites include an easy admin panel where you can change texts, photos, prices and hours without touching code. And if you need help, I'm here.
FAQ.q5: What if I don't have a logo, photos or copy?
FAQ.a5: Don't worry, it's more common than you think. I can guide you with logo design, use professional stock photography and write your website copy. All included in the project.
FAQ.q6: How much does monthly maintenance cost?
FAQ.a6: Hosting and domain cost €10-30/month depending on the project. Technical maintenance (updates, security, backups) starts from €49/month. Many clients don't need ongoing maintenance.
FAQ.q7: Do you work remotely or only in person?
FAQ.a7: I work with clients anywhere in the world. The process is 100% digital: video calls, online deliveries and smooth communication via WhatsApp or email. No matter where you are.
FAQ.q8: What's this AI thing? Is it useful for my business?
FAQ.a8: AI can automate repetitive tasks in your business: answer common questions, send appointment reminders, manage inventory, generate social media content... If something takes up your time every day, AI can probably do it for you.

packages.title: What almost every business repeats
packages.lead: These are the three cases most businesses share, and they work for any sector. If yours is something else, it goes custom. Prices exclude VAT (21%).
packages.details: See what is and isn't included

p1.name: Quote by voice note
p1.audience: For anyone who goes, looks and then has to give a price: renovations, installers, garages, carpentry, gardening, cleaning or removals.
p1.summary: After the visit you send a WhatsApp voice note, a text or photos of what you saw. In a few minutes you get the draft quote as a PDF with your line items or services, your prices and your logo, to review, tweak and send yourself. Every quote is logged in a sheet: client, amount, date and status.
p1.deadline: 10 working days from the moment I have your price list and your template
includes: Loading your price list: up to 300 line items or services, from your Excel or from 5-10 past quotes
30 minutes of training by video call
excludes: Send anything to your client without your approval. Ever
Make up prices: whatever is not in your price list comes out as “price pending”
Decide the applicable VAT rate: you set it
Take-offs from plans, technical or regulatory calculations, invoices or Verifactu
Integration with your management software: that goes custom
p1.youProvide: Your price list or past quotes, your logo and your terms. WhatsApp on your phone.
p1.note: The price list works the same for building line items as for garage services: yours gets loaded.

p2.name: No client left unanswered
p2.audience: For anyone who gets enquiries through their website, email or business WhatsApp: estate agents, garages, shops, adult training centres or professional firms.
p2.summary: When an enquiry comes in through your website form, by email or on your business WhatsApp, it replies in under a minute, at any hour, saying it is an AI assistant. It asks for what you need to handle it (what they want, where, photos if needed, timing and when they'd like a call), logs it in a sheet and sends a summary to your phone.
includes: The question script, tailored to you
The notice that the reply comes from an AI assistant
Optional: a reminder to the client a few days after you send the quote, which you switch on case by case
30 days of adjustments and 30 minutes of training
excludes: Give prices, commit to dates or close sales
Handle complaints: it passes them to you right away
p2.youProvide: Access to your contact form or mailbox and, for WhatsApp, your business number and the documents Meta asks for.
p2.note: WhatsApp depends on Meta verifying your company: if that is delayed, it starts with web and email, and WhatsApp is added later at no cost. Messages charged by Meta are passed on at cost: replying within 24 hours is free and only messages sent after that window are paid (cents per message).

p3.name: Invoices without typing
p3.audience: For any freelancer or company that receives supplier invoices and receipts.
p3.summary: Supplier invoices and receipts that you forward to your paperwork address or send as a photo on WhatsApp are read automatically, filed in your Drive by month and supplier and logged in a sheet (date, supplier, net, VAT, total and, if you use it, job or project), ready for your accountant. It flags what doesn't add up: missing tax ID, odd VAT or a duplicate invoice.
p3.deadline: 7 working days from the moment you set up the forwarding
includes: Your paperwork address, with the forwarding filter already set up
excludes: Access to your whole mailbox: only what you forward gets in
p3.youProvide: Gmail or Google Workspace and Google Drive. Outlook and Microsoft 365, not yet.
p3.note: It's the same system I use for my own freelance accounts.

fee.title: What the {fee} monthly fee per automation covers
fee.body: Hosting, AI, monitoring, fixes and one small change a month, such as updating your price list. The first month is included in the setup. One automation is whatever you can name in one sentence (“it prepares my quotes”): two packages are two fees. If you go over the included usage two months in a row, we talk: there are no automatic overage charges. No lock-in: cancel with 30 days' notice.

custom.title: Is yours something else?
custom.lead: In the assessment I give you a fixed price within one of these bands. Plus {fee} a month per automation, all + VAT.

t1.name: One task
t1.body: A process with the tools you already use: email, sheets, Drive, WhatsApp or forms. If it fits in a package, it costs the same as a package.
t1.examples: Orders from a form, into your sheet and with an alert on your phone. Reading delivery notes from a photo and logging them. A daily sales summary on WhatsApp.

t2.name: A process connected to your software
t2.body: It reads from or writes to your management software, your CRM or your online store through its API, or carries rules specific to your business.
t2.examples: The quote by voice note that goes straight into your software. Online store orders, into your warehouse. Follow-up of sent quotes, in your CRM.

t3.name: Several processes
t3.body: 2 to 4 automations that pass data to each other, or an assistant that queries your business data over WhatsApp.
t3.examples: From the accepted quote to the job in the calendar and the pending-payment alert. An internal WhatsApp that answers “how much does this client owe us?”.
t3.deadline: Each phase, up to 20 working days. You can stop after any phase and keep what already works

custom.honestTitle: If it isn't worth it for you, I'll say so
custom.honestBody: I do the maths with your numbers: the hours it takes you each month and what your hour is worth. If the setup plus a year of fees doesn't pay for itself within 12 months, I won't sell it to you. And if a cheap tool already solves it, I'll tell you which one.

cases.title: One case per video

items.title: You see it working with your data
items.body: Delivery within the deadline of the package or the band. You pay the second 50% and the monthly fee starts.

conditions.title: Terms that take risk off you
conditions.lead: They apply equally to the packages and to custom work.

items.title: Payment in two halves
items.body: 50% when you accept the scope sheet and 50% on delivery, once you see it working with your real data.

items.title: If it doesn't meet the sheet, you get your money back
items.body: If on delivery it doesn't do what the sheet says and it isn't fixed within 10 working days, you get back what you paid and pay nothing more.

items.title: No lock-in
items.body: The monthly fee is cancelled with 30 days' notice.

items.title: Your data, in your account
items.body: Sheets, PDFs and documents live in your Google Drive. If you cancel, you keep them.

items.title: You approve what goes out
items.body: Everything the AI prepares for one of your clients is approved by you before it goes out. The only exception is the data-gathering messages in package 2: they present themselves as an AI assistant and never give prices or dates.

items.title: Support included in the fee
items.body: By WhatsApp or email, Monday to Friday, with a reply within one working day. It is not 24/7 support.

conditions.foundersBody: The first 5 clients, package or custom, get 3 months of the fee free instead of 1, in exchange for a two-sentence testimonial and permission to show their case with anonymised data.
conditions.capacityBody: I don't take more than two at once. If I'm full, I'll give you a start date.

about.videosBody: The videos for my own products are edited, scheduled and published automatically. When one goes out, it shows up here without me touching the site. The latest:

items.q: Do I have to change software?
items.a: No. It works with the tools and the WhatsApp you already use, and what it produces stays in your Google Drive and in a sheet of yours. Connecting it to your management software goes custom, and only if the software has an API or exports files.

items.q: Does the AI send anything to my clients without me seeing it?
items.a: No. Quotes and everything it prepares for a client are approved by you before they go out. The only exception is the data-gathering messages in package 2: they present themselves as an AI assistant and never give prices or dates.

items.q: Mine isn't any of the three examples. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes: it goes custom. After the assessment I give you a fixed price within its band: a single task, €690 to €1,490; a process connected to your software, €1,500 to €3,000; several processes, €3,000 to €6,000 per phase. Plus €49/month per automation, all + VAT.

items.q: What if it doesn't work for me?
items.a: Before starting we agree a sheet with what it has to do and how it is checked. If on delivery it doesn't meet it and it isn't fixed within 10 working days, I refund what you paid.

items.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
items.a: It stays with you: sheets, PDFs and documents are in your Google account from day one.

items.q: In the quote by voice note, what if something is not in my price list?
items.a: It comes out marked as “price pending” so you can set the price yourself. It does not make up prices.

Issue invoices (you issue them from your own software), bookkeeping or tax advice, cold mass mailings by email or WhatsApp, AI that makes decisions about people (screening candidates or granting credit), general-purpose chatbots and AI voice calls. For now I don't work with sectors that handle health data or data about minors either.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Spain?
items.a: For now, only with businesses in Spain.
